prayerExcerpt.en-US: "When I was in church for the novena of Pentecost, it seemed to me that I was in Paradise."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Quando eu estava na igreja para a novena de Pentecostes, parecia-me estar no Paraíso."

meta.face: A Lucchese noblewoman of about sixty-five with a warm, lightly sallow complexion and a LONG, STRONG-BONED face ending in a SQUARE, slightly PROMINENT chin — THICK, dark, STRAIGHT, LEVEL brows set LOW over deep-set, HOODED dark eyes, a LONG, strong nose with a broad, ROUNDED tip, flat cheeks with long creases from the nose to the mouth, a WIDE, thin-lipped mouth with a faint, knowing smile; the gaze direct and earnest.
meta.basis: Her photograph (Wikimedia Commons, early 1900s) and the Dicastery's portrait drawn from it: a long, strong face with thick, level, low-set brows over deep-set, hooded eyes, a long nose with a rounded tip, long cheek creases, a wide thin mouth and a square chin, in a black veil and white collar. The dove is her devotion; Lucca is the city she hardly ever left.
meta.excerpt: Her own recollection, «quando mi trovavo in chiesa per la novena di Pentecoste, mi sembrava di essere in Paradiso», as quoted by L'Osservatore Romano (October 2024) and the Dicastery's biography; our rendering (she died in 1914)

sources.title: Dicastery for the Causes of Saints, Elena Guerra (biography and portrait)
